title: Little interest, but liked traveling; not playing all night for a dollar
summary: Eddie says he got little interest after joining but liked traveling, and would have gone to California if Lawrence had. The sibling says Lawrence was a wonderful banjoist. Eddie would not play all night for a dollar.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters
